messages.subject: Customizing the unmarked functions
parts:
For my own purposes, I edited the occu function in unmarked so that the user can choose a complementary log-log link function for Psi, instead of the logit link.  This choice of link function directly relates occupancy to site-level abundance, assuming abundance is Poisson distributed.   Andy Royle asked me to post the code here so you can see an example of how to edit functions.   

I am not a very elegant R programmer as you will see, but it works.  I had to copy and paste a bunch of functions from the github site and run them locally so I have attached two files.  One contains all the functions I had to edit (unmarked_cloglog_Pois.R), and the other contains all the ones I didn't edit but needed to run (unmarkedfunctions.R).  I'm sure someone can do it more efficiently.

The unmarked_cloglog_Pois.R file contains the following:

1) an edited version of occu called occu.chooselink
2) an edited link function and summary method
3) a data simulation that goes as follows:

Sorry my cursor jumped when I was typing and I accidentally posted before I was done.   I was going to say, the simulation goes as follows

1)      Generate true N from Poisson distribution

2)      Generate p from binomial distribution

3)      Generate counts (C) using the binomial(N,p) distribution

4)      Generate observed presence (y) as C>0


Then there is the data analysis and some descriptive graphs of the model output vs. observations
